patch.value: Refuse promotion when a protected task cohort regresses

Extend the existing predeclared evaluation plan with selected cohort evidence minimums and exact nonregression limits, typed SDK and compact CLI reports. Retain existing promotion, provenance, contamination and shadow gates. Validate with seeded state models, interleavings, packed hosts and a read-only public tracker replay.
Higher aggregate mean cannot override a failed protected cohort; definitions and limits are sealed before collection; insufficient independent samples refuse; leakage checks remain independent

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked against current CLI and sibling pm-jev, pm-evidence, pm-swarm, pm-rlm and pm-ops sources: no protected-cohort admission gate found. Existing evaluation plans, paired baselines, balanced-intake objectives, contamination and shadow checks own distinct properties. Extend the existing sealed plan and promotion hook; no label reinterpretation or replacement gate. Use pinned SDK complete reads, verified creation history, native leases and explicit relationship unsets; no import/export/sync adapter or recovery journal is introduced.

Aggregate improvement stays visible and required; cohort evidence counts independent units and uses inclusive exact rational regression comparisons in original reward units. Registration/evidence writers share SDK lease fencing, and writes explicitly unset ambient parent/sprint/release/blocker scope and clear dependencies. Focused CLI, leakage-independence and every-SDK-step competing-writer tests pass; 500 seeded state sequences are running.

General rule: every producer must prove its complete encoded envelope fits the same byte/depth contract as its consumer before persistence; independent per-field cardinality bounds are insufficient. The 32-cohort reservation can expand beyond the 16 MiB stored decoder ceiling. Branch is not behind origin/main, and the worktree was clean. Review sources contain one blocking finding and no additional actionable non-blocking findings. Auditing all package JSON producers/readers, including the 1 MiB discovery envelopes, external artifacts, SDK/CLI commands and packed hosts; preserve already readable legacy records.
